name: 86 Chaos 17.0.30
label: 86 Chaos 17.0.30
releaseTitle: Testing Domain Cutover and Presence Retirement
notes: Moves release-gate testing to the permanent testing.86chaos.com branch domain and explicitly locks that host to the testing Firebase project.

Retires the online-status and last-seen subsystem: no presence listeners, heartbeats, presence APIs, RTDB status rules, roster badges, System Administrator presence screens, or last-online displays remain.
Makes the installed PWA name 86chaos testing only on testing.86chaos.com while production keeps the 86 Chaos installed-app identity.
Retires the already-passed 17.0.25 delta clean-baseline regression from the current targeted test set while preserving the delta runner itself.
